product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code platform for enterprises to build applications and automate and orchestrate business processes connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots.

employee_band.notes: Company-size range reported on Bizagi’s LinkedIn page.

hq_location.notes: Washington DC is Bizagi’s stated headquarters location.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index shows product, business-process and AI thought leadership rather than engineer-authored articles explaining Bizagi’s implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public platform documentation includes API material and separate guides for AI Agents, AI Workers, Ask Ada and the knowledge layer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open title: AI‑First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure), requisition JR676. This is an AI-focused software-development role, not a dedicated ML research role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT through Microsoft Azure’s Private OpenAI service
model_provider.notes: The documentation explicitly names Azure’s Private OpenAI GPT service; it does not specify a fixed model version.

compliance_certs.notes: Bizagi states ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and independently reviewed compliance with HIPAA/HITECH requirements. GDPR is described as a commitment to providing compliance features, so it is not counted as completed certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile reports $48 million across one round and identifies the latest round as private equity on September 13, 2017, with Invus.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile’s most recent recorded round is September 2017, before the requested window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current eight-role job board lists no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive role. A previously indexed BDR vacancy’s canonical page is no longer available.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi announced AI Advisor on November 5, 2026, within the requested window. It analyzes process performance and ranks opportunities for AI-agent deployment.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Samir Gulati’s profile dates the end of his Bizagi Chief Marketing Officer role to April 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce and HubSpot appear in a marketing job’s tool requirements. The documentation names connectors for HubSpot and the other listed systems; these integration signals do not establish internal deployment.
